edge_claim_requirements: precommitted strategy and stress assumptions frozen
separate untouched repricing holdout or forward period evaluated once
executable cost and depth assumptions remain positive

stability_requirements.moderate: positive expectancy in all assets and both sides; positive in at least 4 chronological folds
stability_requirements.strong: positive after stress in all assets, both sides, and at least 80% of chronological folds; no single asset/session >40% of PnL
stability_requirements.weak: positive expectancy overall and in at least 2 of 3 assets; both sides not materially negative
